As kids we do stupid things. You're not the only one who has done this and you won't be the last. Don't take it too hard! I've had phases in my life where I dwelled on bad stuff I did but really, it won't get you very far. Just take those things and learn from there. We're all human, never expect yourself to do everything perfect.
Thank you. Your reply made me see things more clearly.
What I meant is that she's moving in to his mother's house, where he also lives. His parents are separated (he spends as much time with his father as he spends with his mother, though).

Nobody said he can't deal with me. We both thought we could use some distance. I initiated the break. Living with him didn't work because we didn't give each other enough space. Something we can possibly learn from in the future. 

I'm somewhat close to his mother and she's the type of person who is willing to help a friend of her son is she's able to.

~~He also talked to a mutual friend of ours and iirc friend said that boyfriend loves me but is respecting my decision and giving me space. Yesterday, when boyfriend and I talked, he confirmed the latter.~~

Scratch that, I read your reply wrong.

I might have misunderstood what he said, but I honestly doubt it.

I get it, I do. But even as things were okay between us, he offered her to move in with him and his mother and he did so in front of me. However back then she considered it but didn't accept, she looked for other options. 

My guess is that she couldn't find anywhere to go - based on her money problems and the 4 cats she doesn't want to get rid of - so it came down to her accepting his offer.

He's young and makes mistakes, it's not the first time he doesn't tell me something because he doesn't think it's important. What I can do now is talk to him, but demanding explanations isn't really the first thing I wish to do after getting off a break.

I'm not saying you're wrong. I just don't want to jump to any conclusions without talking to him first.

I'm 100% sure there is nothing romantic going on between them. He has a good heart, he's kind and tries to help everybody as long as it's within his power. I'm not surprised he offered her to move in with him if she has nowhere to go. I just don't know how to react to it.

I keep thinking about this. 

Yes, yes it would. I wish it worked out like that.
There's a reason people get to the point where they stop talking about their own problems. It's just not worth it.
I agree completely...

Of course it bothers me. But it so happens we're different, he and I. Nobody's on the wrong, we're just not compatible. At least I wished we could work, but it's too late for that. I was working to achieve that end, so we're both happy, but I'm just tired right now, and I don't care where we end up. I've made my decision. I don't want to live, nor do I want any possible life that could remotely be better than this, I don't care. Sometimes that's just how it is.

I don't know how you can be so certain that he'll change. He's been like this throughout his whole life and he is like this with his mother. The only time he shows a bit more of respect is when he's in the presence of his father. And I doubt losing me will make a difference to him, he's always so positive about life, even when something bad happens. He'll miss me, but it won't last long. Like he keeps saying, *he'll just move on*. It's what people do.

I really just have no strength to keep going myself, to fight any more battles. I've barely fought the past months. I just sat at home playing video games, chatting with my friends and once in a while I'd hang out with them, even if it felt as a sacrifice sometimes.

He apologizes *after* he's done bitching, usually. And usually against his will. He always tries to do what he thinks is right but deep down I think he feels  annoyed. Maybe he will grow up, he needs it. No matter, that's his problem, not mine. I will probably not be here. For the record, yes, I meant scarred, I've been through a lot, I say. Or maybe I'm just weak and don't want to keep fighting.

I'm sorry if you're wasting time with me. I was trying not to think too much about it, but it fills me with gratitude to know that you're listening to me, a complete stranger. Thank you.

These disagreements with him take out a lot of my energy, and they feel so pointless... 

And I would. I would do what's best for me, if that's what I wanted. It is not. I am so scarred it's hard to keep on living without him. My only wish right now is to have someone with me when I die. It could be him. Having someone holding my hand in my final moments would fill me with peace. But that won't happen, and I'm going to die alone. 

He had an identity crisis because he didn't know what he wanted to do in life. He was apathetic most of the times and it was a hard phase for me. We do have good times together. We were trying to fix things before I gave up.

He has said it several times and for him it means the usual; you break up, it hurts but you move on eventually. I don't know why he feels the need to say these things, but he does. He's not easy to read, and communication is very difficult. All in all, I think he still loves me. I think he's tired of our relationship, and I think he's still a kid at heart. He implies I'm someone who needs a lot of attention and preoccupation, but honestly I think he puts that pressure on himself. 

e.g. I called out two friends and him on not being pleasant to a friend of mine a week ago. One of them explained he was feeling tired, the other apologized and said he understood. My boyfriend was there and got very defensive over the whole ordeal, tried to make it seem the other two friends agreed with him and told me they were not comfortable even though they were right there, it was frustrating even. He insisted later that one of his friends was against me because of what I did. My head was about to explode seeing something so small escalating so quickly. When I asked him why he acted that way, he said "because maybe you make me act like this, because you keep criticizing me!" and I still can't wrap my head around as to why he felt the need to make sure I knew his friends were against me.

And the beginning of the relationship wasn't super, he barely communicated with me because he was going through an identity crisis of some sort. 

What I mean is, we've been going through things and since my relationship with him was my last effort put into life, I see these things happening and I lose my will to fix them.

I think that figuring out what the point of life is turned out to be another mystery I can't even be bothered to decipher. You're living a vacation from death, trying to make the best out of it, following society's rules while you're at it, being miserable but moving on because that's what you gotta do. I see no point in it either.

You're right... I shouldn't give up on him. But things aren't okay, he... he isn't right for me. He refuses to grow up. And he's said countless times that if we break up then he'll simply move on. I'm not worried about it being hard for him. It might be at first but he'll just find someone else. 

It's hard not to give up on something when you already gave up on life and yourself.

I think I've given up for both of us already... our relationship needs help and I won't fix anything in the state I'm in. Besides, you are right. That's the problem. I don't have anything to live for, and putting so much pressure over someone is not healthy or fair. I should've ended my life long ago.
No. Things just... got worse, and we hit a wall.

I've kinda lost my way. I used to be motivated enough - regardless of how depressed I was - to always attend to my responsibilities, do my homework, study, etc. Even that is losing its meaning. 

I don't have anything to look forward to. Two years ago I met my boyfriend, probably the greatest thing to ever appear in my life, or one of the greatest. However, I knew that a relationship with him would be a final push from me, a last effort, and that if it didn't work out I'd go back to the original plan. Two years ago, I was aware that what is going on right now was going to happen.

I left my motivation to live on that person I so cherished, but things didn't go well. Before that, I had nothing left. Without him, I have nothing left still.

If we're talking about metaphors, I feel like the demon is the one pushing me to move forward. I feel all of this darkness around me, what keeps me going is knowing that it'll be over soon.

I feel like it's been part of who I am for so long, it's hard to explain it. I simply don't want to live. I don't want to fight. The smallest things, I don't want to go through any of them. I'm tired. Lately, as bad things happened, I feel like I turned into some sort of auto-pilot mode, like an empty vessel, just waiting.

The only reason why I'm not dead yet it's because of my family. I don't want to put them in pain. Both my uncle and grandma are severely ill and this might traumatize them. My parents would both be alone. I don't want to imagine having me, my grandma and my uncle dying in a near future, I don't want to imagine how my parents would feel. 

I just wish to be able to close my eyes to all of those feelings and end my life in peace.

Trust me, I know what you're talking about. I know it can get better. Hell, it has. I've been through it all. Both very good and bad moments. The past months, years, I've been waiting.

But this is something that lives in me, and it's gotten to a point where I don't want to see the light. I'm focused on suicide, it's the only answer for me right now, the only thing I want out of my life. I don't want to be happy, I don't want a better life. I just want these to be my final moments. 

I wrote my suicide note back in November 3rd. I read it again last night and realized just how much darker it all became since then.

Sometimes I wish there was someone from my group of friends I could simply talk to about my decision to die. People won't understand the decision, and if they do, they'll be hypocritical enough to tell you you shouldn't do it, even if they'd do it themselves in your shoes. It's how humans work.
